copy_gaps: "Offline — retry stopped" (E17-D01 L102's chip state offline, quoted by §5 L400) is annotated, not drawn: §0 L72 plans one frame and L36-37 list no inset for board 30, so the frame shows the first reading, "Reconnecting (3)"; the second changes only the chip (no counter, E17-D01 L102). Carry for the boards PR (standing gate R4: every state the text names has a frame or a named inset; the frame list and the state tables reconcile): §0 L72's frame cell becomes "`SCR-030/fp-disconnected` (chip "Reconnecting (3)"; "Offline — retry stopped" annotated)". The alternative, if the owner prefers it: add 30 to §0 L36-37's inset boards and draw a status-row inset with the offline chip.

The countdown: E18-D02 gives only "bar close 0:41" (§4.6 L314; §4.1 L216). The frame draws E11-D02 §10's 'the countdown reads —' (L413) as "bar close —", the form E11-D02's board 09 draws (the label kept, the value a dash); no E18-D02 key exists for it (E18-D05's copy deck).

The announcements are E17-D01 §7's (L215 entry, L224 counters never re-announced, L226 recovery), quoted as their owner writes them; E18-D02 adds no announcement for this state (§8.2 L749-750). The recovery sentence is not quoted: E17-D01's example ('1 order filled') is SCR-152's reconcile data.

Last-good time: §8.3 L765 ('chip and strip words with the age and the last-good time') and `14` L682 ('chart frozen with last-good timestamp'; L728 'the pane frozen with its last-good time') name it; the disconnected copy gives the age only ('last data 00:12', E11-D02 L413; 'Last data 00:12 ago', E17-D01 L154), so the held frame's time, 13:39:07 (derived: now 13:39:19, §5 L399, less 12 s), is not drawn (that would invent copy) and is named only in these notes and the .md. The time form is the stale chip's ('Stale 7s · last 13:39:12', §5 L399; board 29). Proposed carry for §8.3 L765: 'chip and strip words with the age, and for stale the last-good time'.

The centred strip has no CMP id (E11-D02 L413 calls it a strip; SCR-152's list names CMP-028, CMP-076, CMP-077, CMP-078 for the banner and shading), no size and no type: drawn 24 px high (the compact chrome row, §3 L176), 224 px wide (the estimate plus 16 px), type.ui.label (the kit's compact UI type, as in its strip row); the dot's size is not given (drawn 8 px).
Bar times 12:50-13:20: §4.1 names only 13:25, 13:30 and 13:35 (L225-227); the older bars are the kit's 5-minute steps back from the forming 13:35 (bar_times), as on the kit's other SCR-030 boards.
Price labels 63,975.0-64,010.0: §3 L192-193 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT and §4.1 the five 64,009.0-64,013.0 (L220-224); the window is this board's (deviation).

deviations: Window 63,975.0-64,014.0 and 13:35's five §4.1 levels: board 20's two placements (gen_20.py; board 28's streaming frame, gen_28.py, uses them at the time of writing), so the frozen frame is the streaming frame: the forming cap draws 1 px above 13:35's high (kit 'clip' drops it on the base grid's window) and 13:35's POC is §4.1's 64,011.0 (289 BTC; with the generator's rows under it the base grid's POC is 63,998.0, 326 BTC, as boards 02, 03, 05 and 06 record). The bars' 63,974.0 row lies below the window, cut by clip_to_view(). Still 40 rows of 17.6 px (§3 L185).

The feed chip is composed as E11-D02 L413 / L411 give it: a canvas-filled pill (color.surface.canvas + the 1 px color.border.default hairline), radius.badge, 8 px padding, 20 px, with a 8 px ink dot (k.chip() draws outlined pills without a dot). The dot's hue (the reconnecting / disconnected indicator) is hi-fi's (E18-D03); here chip and strip dots are one ink in either reading, so the words carry the state (§5 L393 'no state relies on colour'; §8.3 L765).

The countdown reads 'bar close —' (E11-D02 L413 and its board 09), not the kit's 'bar close 0:41': status_row() is the kit's status row with that one string and the chip; the readout ('last 64,011.0 · spread 0.1') stays frozen as last received (E11-D02 gives no change for it).

The scrim covers the pane row (drawing rail, plot, price gutter: E11-D02's 'pane stack'); the toolbar, the status row, the E12-D02 strip row and the time strip stay unscrimmed, as E11-D02's board 09 draws the disconnected frame (its time strip unscrimmed).

Local helpers in gen_30.py (e18kit lacks them; e18kit.py not edited): feed_chip(), status_row(), centred_strip(), dot(), panel_rows() (k.panel() takes no ColGeo and draws its own status row), build_scene() and clip_to_view() (as gen_20.py / gen_28.py), pin_all(), the checks and the .md writer.
The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the 40-row window; every bar spans the window (§3 L193: every row traded), so the wick runs top to bottom; the body is filled (its form is E12-D06's, §4.1 D3).
Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared: `24` §4.2's treat_as_min would flag every bar's high (sell) and low (buy); the §4.1 anatomy draws no such flag (L220-224).

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
